_comment: HOK-3322: one table for the Ready remediation disposition. Provenance: the first case is a production incident replay from HOK-3316 / PR #1720 (2026-10-26); the remaining cases are hand-authored boundary siblings derived from that incident's documented monitor/watchdog decision sites. shared/lib/ready-remediation-disposition.test.ts runs every case through the pure decision; tests/ready-remediation-disposition.test.sh materialises the `shell: true` cases (state dir, bucket, conflict marker, ownership row, agent hook file) and asserts the monitor's wrapper prints the same kind and reason. Times are seconds before now. `launch.head` is `current` (equal to HEAD) or `other` (a head the worktree moved past).

cases.name: incident: CI remediation agent idle after launch at the same head
cases.protects: HOK-3316/PR #1720: an agent that reran flaky CI without committing held Ready forever

cases.name: live remediation agent still working at the same head
cases.protects: re-running Ready (and so relaunching) over a remediation agent that is still working

cases.name: previous stage's Stop predates the remediation launch
cases.protects: the reviewer's idle:Stop releasing a remediation agent that has not started yet

cases.name: remediation agent cut off mid-response (StopFailure)
cases.protects: an errored agent holding the arm as if it were still working

cases.name: remediation agent waiting on operator approval
cases.protects: re-running Ready behind an agent parked at an approval prompt

cases.name: no agent record yet just after launch
cases.protects: settling a remediation before its agent has reported anything

cases.name: remediation pushed a new head
cases.protects: new-head remediation losing the existing pending re-check and condition expiry

cases.name: Ready already completed
cases.protects: a stale bucket head holding a completed Ready

cases.name: Ready running with nothing launched (pending CI)
cases.protects: a pending Ready being held as if remediation were in flight

cases.name: conflict resolver idle after launch at the same head
cases.protects: a resolver that settled without pushing latching the conflict branch

cases.name: conflict resolver still working
cases.protects: re-running Ready over a live conflict resolver

cases.name: idle agent waiting on its own background job
cases.protects: HOK-3137: an agent idle on its own backgrounded test run read as settled

cases.name: agent parked at a blocking interactive prompt
cases.protects: re-running Ready behind an agent waiting on a menu choice

cases.name: agent process exited without a hook
cases.protects: a crashed remediation agent holding the arm

cases.name: no agent evidence and stalled past the threshold
cases.protects: an unreporting remediation latching instead of reaching the bounded re-check

cases.name: a live record wins over stalled
cases.protects: relaunching over an agent inside one long tool call

cases.name: unknown launch time attributes no record
cases.protects: a pre-launch Stop releasing the hold when the launch time is unrecorded

cases.name: progress probe failed
cases.protects: a failed probe relaunching work (fail safe is hold)
